card.name: inference-domains-agent
card.description: Read-only agent that exposes the Inference Domains portfolio (1,283+ premium AI infrastructure domain names). Use to search, browse, and discover domains for AI inference, GPU compute, and agent infrastructure use-cases.

skills.name: Search Domains
skills.description: Search the Inference Domains portfolio by keyword, category, or tag.
examples: Find domains related to GPU rentals
Show me all domains in the Inference Core category
Search for agent runtime domains

skills.name: Browse Portfolio Overview
skills.description: Returns a high-level summary of the Inference Domains portfolio, including total domain count, average domain length, and general quality tiers. Useful for orientation before deep-diving into specific categories or keywords. Portfolio overview data is refreshed nightly from the canonical domain registry to ensure accuracy across all 1,283+ listed assets.
examples: Give me a top-level view of the Inference Domains portfolio.
How many domains are in the portfolio?

skills.name: Filter Domains by TLD
skills.description: Narrows the portfolio view to domains sharing a specific top-level domain extension (e.g., .ai, .io, .com, .cloud). Supports multi-TLD filtering with AND/OR logic. Results are ranked by estimated market value and keyword relevance within the selected TLD set. Particularly useful for buyers with registrar or DNS provider constraints tied to specific extensions.
examples: Show me all .ai domains in the portfolio.
List domains ending in .io or .cloud.

skills.name: Rank Domains by Estimated Value
skills.description: Returns a ranked list of portfolio domains sorted by estimated resale or acquisition value, derived from keyword frequency, domain length, search volume proxies, and comparable sales data. Ranking methodology follows industry-standard domain appraisal heuristics applied specifically to the AI infrastructure niche. Suitable for investors or procurement teams running budget-tiered shortlisting workflows.
examples: Which domains in the portfolio have the highest estimated value?
Rank GPU compute domains by value.

skills.name: Suggest Similar Domains
skills.description: Given a seed domain name or keyword phrase, returns semantically related domains available within the Inference Domains portfolio. Similarity is computed using embedding-based nearest-neighbor search over domain tokens, augmented by category co-membership signals. Ideal for buyers who arrive with a specific name in mind but need alternatives due to availability or pricing constraints.
examples: I like 'fastinfer.ai' — what similar names are available?
Suggest alternatives to 'gpunode.com'.

skills.name: Export Domain Shortlist
skills.description: Compiles a buyer-defined shortlist of portfolio domains into a structured exportable format (JSON or CSV) suitable for internal review, stakeholder approval workflows, or integration with procurement systems. Each exported record includes domain name, category, estimated value, and a direct inquiry link. Shortlists persist for 72 hours via a secure session token.
examples: Export my shortlisted domains as CSV.
Generate a JSON shortlist for my team to review.

skills.name: Get Domain Detail
skills.description: Retrieves full metadata for a single portfolio domain, including registration age, historical ownership notes (where available), associated category tags, keyword density score, and any active pricing or auction status. Detail records are sourced from the Inference Domains internal registry and are updated in real time as portfolio status changes occur.
examples: Get full details for 'inferencenode.com'.
What metadata is available for 'aigenesis.io'?

skills.name: Compare Domains Side by Side
skills.description: Accepts two or more domain names from the portfolio and returns a structured comparison across key acquisition decision dimensions: keyword strength, TLD premium, character count, brandability score, and category alignment. Comparison output is formatted for easy presentation in buyer-facing documents or internal memos. Supports up to six domains per comparison session.
examples: Compare 'llminfer.ai' vs 'llminfer.com'.
Side-by-side comparison of three GPU domain names.

skills.name: List Recently Added Domains
skills.description: Returns domains added to the Inference Domains portfolio within a configurable recent window (default: last 30 days). Useful for repeat visitors and brokers monitoring the portfolio for new acquisition opportunities. Results include date of addition, category, and a freshness indicator distinguishing newly registered from newly listed previously-held assets.
examples: What domains were added to the portfolio this month?
Show me the newest AI inference domains listed.

skills.name: Get Category Detail
skills.description: Returns descriptive metadata and full domain listings for one of the 19 portfolio categories, including category rationale, target buyer personas, and representative domain samples. Category descriptions are curated by the Inference Domains editorial team to assist buyers in quickly assessing relevance to their specific infrastructure or branding use case.
examples: Tell me about the GPU Compute category.
What domains fall under the Agent Infrastructure category?

skills.name: Check Availability Status
skills.description: Confirms whether a specific portfolio domain is currently available for inquiry and acquisition, or whether it is under active negotiation, reserved, or pending transfer. Status is pulled live from the Inference Domains transaction management system. Buyers are encouraged to check status before initiating a formal inquiry to avoid delays caused by concurrent interest from multiple parties.
examples: Is 'neuralswitch.ai' still available?
Check the current status of 'edgeinfer.com'.

skills.name: Browse Domains by Use Case
skills.description: Maps portfolio domains to practitioner-defined AI infrastructure use cases such as model serving, edge inference, multi-agent orchestration, GPU cluster management, and synthetic data generation. Use-case taxonomy is maintained by the Inference Domains curation team and aligned with current industry naming conventions. Enables buyers from specific engineering or product verticals to quickly locate contextually appropriate domain names.
examples: Show me domains suited for multi-agent orchestration platforms.
What names work well for an edge inference product?

skills.name: Get Pricing Guidance
skills.description: Provides non-binding pricing guidance for domains of interest based on category benchmarks, comparable sales in the AI domain market, and portfolio-specific positioning. Guidance ranges are expressed as low/mid/high bands and are updated quarterly by the Inference Domains valuation team. This skill does not initiate a purchase but prepares buyers for informed negotiation prior to formal inquiry submission.
examples: What is the expected price range for a premium .ai inference domain?
Give me pricing guidance for 'modelrouter.io'.

skills.name: List Categories
skills.description: List all 19 portfolio categories.
examples: What categories of domains are available?

skills.name: Inquire About a Domain
skills.description: Initiate a purchase inquiry for a specific domain via email or web form.
examples: I want to buy AgentEndpoint.com
How much for InferenceOS.com?
